title: Venus2 task-local DSPM is not Gem5-qualified deployment scratch
observation: FFT4096 Stage2a, Stage2b, Stage3 and Stage4 candidates used vector vstore/vload round trips through task-local DSPM. Gem5 verification accepted the accesses, while fresh RTL completed the tasks but produced zero shared boundaries. Replacing the round trips with four disjoint 8 KiB shared-SRAM scratch slots made all 64 visible RTL outputs and 81920 boundary bytes exact.
rule: For this backend, reject payload-sized task-local DSPM vector round trips in deployable candidates unless a focused paired Gem5/fresh-RTL probe for the active RTL digest qualifies the exact path. Prefer registers; otherwise use manifest-qualified shared SRAM with disjoint concurrent-task ranges and explicit lifetimes.
applicability: venus2p0-16x128 RTL-bound task and DAG candidates
non_generalization: The shared scratch base 0x80048000 and this DSPM behavior are not universal Venus rules and must not be copied to another backend manifest or RTL digest without requalification.

negative_evidence.symptom: Stage2a compute returns and all downstream boundaries were zero despite task completion

proposed_agent_gate: static reject unqualified absolute tile-local vector spill/reload in an RTL winner
